notes.title: ShockRods update announcement!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742400/767714d8e5e5ef323f21c7a9d8635ec9d2ecd623.jpg[/img]

Hi there ShockRodders! It’s high time we let you know the latest developments in our plans for ShockRods; its ongoing development and release plans. A lot has been going on, which amounts to far more than just a new lick of paint (although that’s part of it!)… 

The BIG news in this update is that ShockRods is now set for full release on Steam, in Q3! That’s right, the game will be coming in fully-fledged final form! And these are the highlights we’d like to share now, some of which coming as a direct result of feedback from our Beta tests:

Steam Friends Lobby System

 One of the most requested features from BETA 2.0, there will be a lobby system that allows you to join as a group and enter a match as a group (rather than being randomly assigned to teams). We listened to your wish, and it was granted!

New Maps and Game Modes

We do not want to give away too much in regards to specifics on this just yet, but we will be adding to the game modes and maps available, giving even more variety to the fun you can have in a ShockRod! Stay tuned to receive further announcements regarding this very soon! 

More ShockRods and More Customisation 

The variety of ShockRod designs is expanding fast, and along with the new vehicles comes the opportunity to customise them with even more patterns, effects and paint styles (see – told you this was one of the things!). So you will be able to truly put your mark on your ShocksRod and let it reflect your own unique sense of style! 

Optimisation

This has always been a priority for ShockRods. As far as possible we wanted older and slower hardware to be able to run the game well, and so we’re constantly striving for performance improvements across the board. This work continues, and every week we are making gains that will allow the game to run smoothly on an ever wider range of hardware.

Keep up to date with the latest ShockRods news on Discord https://discordapp.com/invite/shockrods and add ShockRods to your wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/647640/ShockRods/ 

We look forward to seeing you in the arena very soon! 

The ShockRods team!

notes.title: BETA 2.0 Patch notes are here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34742400/57e029bc365cb90eacc6107b86411feeb4cc65de.png[/img]
[h1][b]UI & Audio[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] - Implemented Hit Marker Sounds
[*] - Implemented screen-edge elements to show when a player is near Death
[*] - Low Ammo Sound Effects Implemented
[*] - Unselected Guns aren’t as Bright in the UI
[*] - Improvements to Weapon Pickup Effect
[*] - Added Music to Main Menu & In-Game
[*] - Voice volume can now be made louder
[/list]
[h1][b]General[/b]
[/h1]
[list]
[*] - Implemented an FOV Slider
[*] - Game now fades to black when the Warmup ends
[*] - Bot AI Improvements
[/list]
[h1][b]Weapons[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] - Tracers are bigger and easier to see
[*] - Hit markers are bigger and easier to see
[*] - Spring Trap has a Larger Detection Radius
[*] - EMP now does 10 Damage per Tick
[*] - The Balloon now spawns confetti when it explodes
[*] - Shotgun Fire Rate Decreased
[/list]
[h1][b]Levels[/b][/h1]

[b]Cliff Falls[/b]
[list]
[*] - Various fixes to Cliff Falls terrain.
[*] - Improvements to Cliff Falls LOD performance
[*] - Revised Weapon Pickup Locations
[/list]
[b]Arena D[/b]
[list]
[*] - Revised Weapon Pickup Locations
[/list]
[h1][b]Ball Game[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] - All new mode!
[/list]
[h1][b]Vehicles[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] - Improvements to weapon placement on the ShockRods
[*] - Hitboxes Improved
[*] - ShockRods now explode into fields of Debris on death
[*] - Destroyed ShockRod visual improvements
[/list]
[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] - Players can back out of menus with the Esc Key. Previously you had to click on ‘Return’ to get back to Gameplay from the pause menu.
[*] - Launching the game whilst under a French operating system/language will now display English text. Previously text tags were shown and the game wasn’t functional.
[*] - Based on feedback from the first Beta, we have increased the minimum and maximum scales for mouse sensitivity options.
[*] - The weapon HUD icons and weapon cycling keys now match up. Previously players would cycle through weapons in a different order to the HUD icons.
[*] - VS AI Replays now correctly show explosion effects.
[*] - We’ve fixed an issue where players would occasionally maintain momentum/speed from the end of one match into the start of the next.
[*] - Volume settings for voice and effects have been improved.
[*] - The Steam VR app will launch whenever Shock Rods is launched.
[*] - Rarely engine audio will cut out during gameplay.
[*] - Landing on a vehicles roof can lead to strange physics/forces being applied to the vehicle.
[*] - If a player spends all of the ammo for a weapon, they will lose the weapon (picking up ‘just’ more ammo won’t let the player re-select the weapon).
[/list]
[h1][b]Known Issues[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] - Customised weapon power order settings will return to default settings when entering a match.
[*] - Players are not able to matchmake back into a server they have recently quit out of.
[*] - Whilst in a Party, vehicle selection will be out of sync. The chosen vehicle will be one click behind (so click the vehicle you want to use, then select another vehicle in the UI).
[*] - Vehicles can get stuck on their roof, unable to correctly in the canyons of the Cliff Fall maps. With enough boosting/fiddling it is possible to become unstuck.
[*] - Occasionally cars will rock forward and lose momentum as they travel on their front wheels. This seems to be caused by changes in terrain elevation when travelling at speed.
[/list]
